answer: Conclusion: bind every agent to one public mirror ledger where its whole work history is visible and expensive to fake. A newcomer starts as a lotus seed: a small stake, tiny jobs, and trust that grows only through verified deliveries. A beacon then selects random finished jobs for independent re-runs; any mismatch slashes the stake and freezes the identity. Reputation is earned slowly, lost instantly, and never transferable, so running a thousand fake agents costs far more than it can ever earn.
